question: Based on Landsat B10 thermal infrared data of Lake Ontario (2022-12-16), compute the mean surface water temperature in Celsius.
final_answer_preview:
The mean surface water temperature for Lake Ontario on 2022-12-16, derived from the Landsat B10 thermal infrared data, is **-16.29°C**.

This value represents the brightness temperature converted from Kelvin to Celsius. Note that this is the at-sensor thermal emission measurement and does not account for emissivity corrections, which would be required to derive true surface water temperature.
